messages:
maria (devex): Heads-up — I hit a weird edge with editable installs + poetry export -> pip. pip errors with hash mismatches when installing from -e .
jonathan: ugh, can you paste the full error?
maria (devex): here, truncated: 
ERROR: Hash mismatch for 'libfoo==0.1.0' (expected 1234..., got 9abc...)
kevin: do you have the package both as a path dependency and from PyPI in the lockfile? that often causes dup entries
maria (devex): nope, it's only local. repro steps I used:
```
poetry init -n
poetry add -D pytest
poetry export -f requirements.txt --dev --output req.txt --without-hashes
# then in project root
pip install -e .
```
it consistently fails at the editable install step when the exported requirements include the locked libfoo entry
poetry-bot: export finished: requirements.txt created (no-hashes mode)
grace: hmm. pip will still try to verify hashes if a requirements file references a package with hashes — but you said --without-hashes? weird.
jonathan: @maria which poetry/pip versions? and can you paste the pyproject fragment (path dep) and the lock entry for libfoo?
maria (devex): poetry 1.6.1, pip 24.1. pyproject has:
```
[tool.poetry.dependencies]
libfoo = { path = "../libfoo", develop = true }
```
lockfile snippet shows a normal wheel entry for libfoo with a hash
ci-bot: Note: there have been flaky CI runs in the past related to editable/local deps with lockfile exports.
kevin: workaround options: remove the libfoo line from exported requirements, or export without lockfile hashes, or install editable with --no-deps then pip install -r req.txt. ugly workarounds though
maria (devex): yeah not ideal for onboarding. I'm planning to add a short recipe in the quickstart docs describing the supported combo, and a debug script to detect this class of conflict early during `dev` setup
grace: also consider recommending `pip install --use-feature=in-tree-build` or using build isolation flags? some of the in-tree vs wheel metadata differences cause hash checks to fail
jonathan: please open issues upstream for both pip and poetry linking your minimal repro. also add the exact repro repo here so eng can triage.
maria (devex): will do — created repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-repros/editable-hash-mismatch. added minimal pyproject, lock fragment, and install script. filing poetry/pip issues now. thanks for the quick triage :heart:
kevin: thanks for doing the follow-up. saving this for onboarding checklist. :raised_hands:
